title: Architecture boundary cleanup plan
summary: Added an active implementation planning pack and Phase 0 edge ledger for GitHub #23 architecture-boundary cleanup, including dependency-boundary prework, domain counts, target ownership categories, no-new-debt ratchet rules, phased cleanup order, validation expectations, and stop conditions.
reason: Core modules still import desktop compatibility modules across many domains. The cleanup needs a staged source plan so shared DTO/runtime moves happen before domain slices and future refactors avoid moving the same contracts repeatedly.
behavior_before: The open-work checklist identified #23 as domain-by-domain architecture debt, but there was no active implementation plan with a current dependency-boundary baseline, edge categories, phase order, or validation ladder.
behavior_after: The active docs now point #23 to docs/implementation/architecture-boundary-cleanup/README.md as the planning source and docs/implementation/architecture-boundary-cleanup/EDGE_LEDGER.md as the Phase 0 ledger source. Runtime behavior, Local API routes, WebView commands, media policy, and package behavior are unchanged.
